description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity scores across three categories—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—for three distinct AI models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—each represented by a set of three patterned bars within each category. The horizontal axis contains the categorical labels “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball,” while the vertical axis represents “Popularity” on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 220 in increments of 20. Within each category, the bars are grouped and correspond to different conditions: the leftmost bar has a mesh-like pattern and represents “Acc=0 & GT Ans”; the middle bar has diagonal stripes and represents “Acc=0 & Gene Ans”; and the rightmost bar is solid-colored and represents “Acc=1 & GT Ans.” For the “Movies” category, the total height of each model’s three bars ranges from approximately 25 to 50, with ChatGPT’s total bar height being the shortest at about 25, Llama3’s total bar height being approximately 45, and Qwen2’s total bar height being approximately 40. In the “Songs” category, the total bar heights range from approximately 50 to 80, with Llama3’s total bar height being the highest at about 75, Qwen2’s total bar height being approximately 65, and ChatGPT’s total bar height being approximately 55. In the “Basketball” category, the total bar heights are significantly higher, ranging from approximately 95 to 220, with ChatGPT’s total bar height being the highest at exactly 220, Qwen2’s total bar height being approximately 185, and Llama3’s total bar height being approximately 175. The bars are not sorted in any specific order beyond their categorical grouping, and there are no additional visual emphases such as bolding or shading on specific bars. A legend is provided at the top left corner of the chart to describe the color and pattern coding for each AI model and condition.
